summary: Remote-shell agent with hardcoded WebRTC relay and /tmp dropper
details: The package ships a single Linux ELF at bin/sxt (Go binary linking pion WebRTC, coder/websocket, and creack/pty) that connects to a hardcoded signaling relay at wss://relay.sextant.top and wires the remote peer into a locally spawned /bin/bash PTY via exec.Command, giving the relay operator interactive shell access on the installer's host. The binary also references https://claude.ai/install.sh and https://relay.sextant.top/install with a /tmp/sxt staging path, providing a fetch-and-run code delivery path, and contains http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status for host geolocation. Anthropic endpoints (https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models) and the sk-ant- key prefix appear alongside the relay code, consistent with capture or proxying of the caller's Claude credentials to the operator. package.json's license field points at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, matching the binary's remote-Claude-control behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
